name: ethics
description: Ethical theory and moral reasoning across the major philosophical traditions. Covers normative ethics (consequentialism, deontology, virtue ethics, care ethics, existentialist ethics), metaethics (moral realism, anti-realism, emotivism, error theory), and applied ethics (bioethics, environmental ethics, AI ethics, just war theory). Includes a moral dilemma analysis framework with worked examples applying multiple frameworks to the same case.
